K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills.scenario_zh: 科学数据分析与文献综述
K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills.prompt_zh: 请使用已安装的 scientific-agent-skills，基于当前目录下的【experiment_data.csv】做一次探索性统计分析，对比对照组和实验组的显著性差异，并输出一张可直接用于期刊投稿的高清图表及完整 Python 代码。
K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills.prompt_en: Use scientific-agent-skills to run an exploratory statistical analysis on [experiment_data.csv] in this folder, test group significance, and output a publication-ready figure with reproducible Python code.
K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills.output_zh: 自动选择对应科学分析技能，产出统计检验结果、可复现脚本与高清图表。
K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills.output_en: Selects the relevant scientific skill to produce statistical test results, reproducible scripts, and publication-ready figures.

Imbad0202/academic-research-skills.scenario_zh: 文献调研 → 论文初稿全流程
Imbad0202/academic-research-skills.prompt_zh: 请调用 academic-research-skills，围绕主题【多模态大模型在医学影像分割中的小样本泛化】先做一轮近 3 年核心文献脉络梳理，列出 5 个主要研究缺口，并起草一份包含引言与方法框架的论文大纲。
Imbad0202/academic-research-skills.prompt_en: Use academic-research-skills to survey key papers from the past 3 years on [few-shot generalization of multimodal LLMs in medical imaging], list 5 research gaps, and draft a structured paper outline.
Imbad0202/academic-research-skills.output_zh: 按科研阶段输出文献脉络表、研究空白总结与结构化论文大纲。
Imbad0202/academic-research-skills.output_en: Produces a structured literature map, research gap summary, and manuscript outline.

Yuan1z0825/nature-skills.scenario_zh: Nature 风格科研绘图与学术润色
Yuan1z0825/nature-skills.prompt_zh: 请使用 nature-figure 技能，读取当前目录下的【ablation_results.csv】，绘制一张符合 Nature 子刊排版规范的多子图对比折线图（色盲友好配色、Arial 字体、300 DPI PDF 输出），并附上可直接运行的脚本。
Yuan1z0825/nature-skills.prompt_en: Use the nature-figure skill to plot [ablation_results.csv] as a multi-panel Nature-style line figure with colorblind-safe colors, clean typography, and 300 DPI PDF export.
Yuan1z0825/nature-skills.output_zh: 输出符合顶刊视觉规范的配色、版式与高清矢量图表脚本。
Yuan1z0825/nature-skills.output_en: Generates top-journal visual styling, figure script, and high-DPI vector output.

wanshuiyin/Auto-claude-code-research-in-.scenario_zh: 机器学习实验设计与消融规划
wanshuiyin/Auto-claude-code-research-in-.prompt_zh: 请按照 ARIS 研究工作流，阅读当前目录下的【baseline.py】和实验日志，针对【验证集精度停滞】提出 3 个可验证的改进假设，并设计包含控制变量与评估指标的消融实验清单。
wanshuiyin/Auto-claude-code-research-in-.prompt_en: Following the ARIS research workflow, inspect [baseline.py] and logs in this folder, propose 3 testable hypotheses for [validation plateau], and draft a controlled ablation plan.
wanshuiyin/Auto-claude-code-research-in-.output_zh: 生成结构化研究假设、实验优先级与可执行消融方案。
wanshuiyin/Auto-claude-code-research-in-.output_en: Produces structured hypotheses, experiment priorities, and a runnable ablation checklist.

Imbad0202/academic-research-skills-codex.scenario_zh: Codex 科研写作与审稿返修
Imbad0202/academic-research-skills-codex.prompt_zh: 请使用 academic-research-skills-codex 检查当前目录下的【manuscript.tex】与审稿意见【reviewers.md】，逐条整理审稿人核心关切，并给出中肯礼貌的 Point-by-Point Rebuttal 草稿与正文修改建议。
Imbad0202/academic-research-skills-codex.prompt_en: Use academic-research-skills-codex to review [manuscript.tex] against [reviewers.md], categorize every reviewer concern, and draft a point-by-point rebuttal with manuscript edits.
Imbad0202/academic-research-skills-codex.output_zh: 输出逐条对应审稿意见的回复框架与具体段落修改建议。
Imbad0202/academic-research-skills-codex.output_en: Outputs a point-by-point rebuttal draft paired with targeted manuscript revisions.

Orchestra-Research/AI-Research-SKILLs.scenario_zh: AI 工程实验与复现脚手架
Orchestra-Research/AI-Research-SKILLs.prompt_zh: 请从 AI-Research-SKILLs 中选择合适技能，帮我为当前目录的【PyTorch 训练代码】检查数据泄漏风险、补充随机种子固定与评测脚本，并整理一份可复现的实验运行说明。
Orchestra-Research/AI-Research-SKILLs.prompt_en: Select the relevant skill from AI-Research-SKILLs to audit [my PyTorch training repo] for data leakage, add deterministic seeding and evaluation scripts, and document reproduction steps.
Orchestra-Research/AI-Research-SKILLs.output_zh: 给出代码审查要点、复现配置补丁与标准化实验文档。
Orchestra-Research/AI-Research-SKILLs.output_en: Provides audit findings, reproducibility fixes, and standardized run instructions.

HKUSTDial/Supervisor-Skills.scenario_zh: 科研选题评估与博导视角评审
HKUSTDial/Supervisor-Skills.prompt_zh: 请以 Supervisor-Skills 的博导评审视角，审阅我这份开题想法：【用轻量图神经网络预测高校实验室能耗峰值】。请直白指出选题的创新点短板、最可能被审稿人拒稿的 3 个硬伤，以及更稳妥的实验切入点。
HKUSTDial/Supervisor-Skills.prompt_en: Using Supervisor-Skills from a doctoral advisor perspective, critique my proposal on [lightweight GNNs for campus energy peak forecasting]: point out novelty gaps, top 3 rejection risks, and a stronger experiment scope.
HKUSTDial/Supervisor-Skills.output_zh: 输出直击痛点的选题诊断报告、拒稿风险清单与研究收敛建议。
HKUSTDial/Supervisor-Skills.output_en: Delivers a candid advisor critique, rejection risk list, and actionable scoping advice.

ChenLiu-1996/figures4papers.scenario_zh: 顶会/顶刊 Python 论文配图
ChenLiu-1996/figures4papers.prompt_zh: 请使用 scientific-figure-making 技能，将当前目录下的【metrics.csv】画成一张双栏宽度的分组柱状图（含误差棒与显著性标记），严格匹配顶会论文排版字号，输出 Python 绘图代码并导出为 PDF/SVG。
ChenLiu-1996/figures4papers.prompt_en: Use the scientific-figure-making skill to turn [metrics.csv] into a double-column grouped bar chart with error bars and significance markers, exporting clean Python code plus PDF/SVG.
ChenLiu-1996/figures4papers.output_zh: 生成排版比例精确的 Python 绘图脚本与高清矢量论文插图。
ChenLiu-1996/figures4papers.output_en: Produces publication-proportioned Python plotting scripts and vector PDF/SVG figures.

Master-cai/Research-Paper-Writing-Skills.scenario_zh: CS / AI 论文结构与 Introduction 打磨
Master-cai/Research-Paper-Writing-Skills.prompt_zh: 请使用 Research-Paper-Writing-Skills 审阅当前目录下的【intro_draft.tex】，按顶会论文逻辑检查“问题引出 → 现有方法局限 → 本文核心洞察 → 贡献列表”的衔接是否紧密，并给出逐段重写建议。
Master-cai/Research-Paper-Writing-Skills.prompt_en: Use Research-Paper-Writing-Skills to review [intro_draft.tex] for logical flow from problem motivation to limitations, key insight, and contributions, with paragraph-level rewrites.
Master-cai/Research-Paper-Writing-Skills.output_zh: 产出逻辑断层诊断与结构紧致、论点鲜明的改写版本。
Master-cai/Research-Paper-Writing-Skills.output_en: Delivers structural gap analysis and tighter paragraph-level rewrites.

ningzimu/codex-ppt-skill.scenario_zh: 组会 / 答辩学术 PPT 自动生成
ningzimu/codex-ppt-skill.prompt_zh: 请使用 codex-ppt-skill，基于当前目录下的论文草稿【paper.pdf】，提炼一份 10 页的组会汇报 PPT 大纲与每页视觉构图方案（包含背景痛点、方法流程图、核心实验对比和局限讨论），并生成 PPTX 文件。
ningzimu/codex-ppt-skill.prompt_en: Use codex-ppt-skill to turn [paper.pdf] into a 10-slide research presentation outline with visual layout specs covering motivation, method diagram, main results, and limitations, then generate the PPTX.
ningzimu/codex-ppt-skill.output_zh: 输出结构清晰的答辩/组会幻灯片脚本与图文混排 PPT 文件。
ningzimu/codex-ppt-skill.output_en: Generates a clear academic deck plan and visually composed PPTX slides.

dwzhu-pku/PaperBanana.scenario_zh: 学术方法框架图与示意图生成
dwzhu-pku/PaperBanana.prompt_zh: 请使用 PaperBanana，根据我这段方法描述：【输入多光谱图像经特征金字塔编码，与文本提示做跨模态注意力融合后输出病灶分割掩码】，生成一张结构清晰、适合放在论文 Section 3 的模型整体架构示意图。
dwzhu-pku/PaperBanana.prompt_en: Use PaperBanana to generate a clean Section 3 architecture diagram from this method description: [multispectral image enters an FPN encoder, fuses with text prompts via cross-attention, and outputs lesion masks].
dwzhu-pku/PaperBanana.output_zh: 自动拆解模块关系与数据流向，生成论文级学术架构示意图。
dwzhu-pku/PaperBanana.output_en: Decomposes modules and data flow into a publication-style academic schematic.

larashero3-dotcom/lieflat-charts.scenario_zh: 交互式数据可视化图表
larashero3-dotcom/lieflat-charts.prompt_zh: 请使用 lieflat-charts 读取当前目录的【survey_data.csv】，制作一个可交互筛选各年份与分组指标的 HTML 数据看板，支持悬停查看精确数值与一键导出图片。
larashero3-dotcom/lieflat-charts.prompt_en: Use lieflat-charts to turn [survey_data.csv] into an interactive HTML chart view with year/group filtering, hover tooltips, and image export.
larashero3-dotcom/lieflat-charts.output_zh: 生成美观、可直接用浏览器打开汇报的交互式 HTML 图表页。
larashero3-dotcom/lieflat-charts.output_en: Produces a polished standalone HTML interactive visualization ready for demos.

Adkid-Zephyr/anti-defensive-writing-Skil.scenario_zh: 消除学术写作中的“防御性表达”
Adkid-Zephyr/anti-defensive-writing-Skil.prompt_zh: 请使用 anti-defensive-writing 技能通读我的论文段落【discussion_draft.md】，标出所有过度铺垫、自我削弱或逃避主论点的“防御性句子”，并改成论点直接、证据扎实、不卑不亢的学术表达。
Adkid-Zephyr/anti-defensive-writing-Skil.prompt_en: Use anti-defensive-writing on [discussion_draft.md] to flag hedging or overly defensive phrasing and rewrite each sentence into direct, evidence-backed academic prose.
Adkid-Zephyr/anti-defensive-writing-Skil.output_zh: 列出每处防御性表述的问题原因与前后改写对照表。
Adkid-Zephyr/anti-defensive-writing-Skil.output_en: Lists flagged defensive phrases with explanations and direct before/after rewrites.

ScrapeCreators/social-media-research-ski.scenario_zh: 社媒传播数据与评论主题分析
ScrapeCreators/social-media-research-ski.prompt_zh: 请使用 social-media-research-skills，对当前目录收集的【comments_sample.csv】进行高互动帖特征拆解与评论情感/主题聚类，总结受众最关注的前 5 个痛点并给出代表性原话摘录。
ScrapeCreators/social-media-research-ski.prompt_en: Use social-media-research-skills on [comments_sample.csv] to identify outlier engagement patterns, cluster comment themes, and summarize the top 5 audience concerns with representative quotes.
ScrapeCreators/social-media-research-ski.output_zh: 输出爆款特征分析、评论主题分布与带原文佐证的研究摘要。
ScrapeCreators/social-media-research-ski.output_en: Produces outlier patterns, comment clusters, and quote-backed research summaries.

jihe520/MathModelAgent.scenario_zh: 数学建模全流程与竞赛论文撰写
jihe520/MathModelAgent.prompt_zh: 请使用 MathModelAgent 阅读当前目录的赛题【problem.pdf】与附件数据【data.xlsx】，先完成问题重述、模型假设与符号说明，再给出问题一的数学模型构建、Python 求解代码及结果灵敏度分析。
jihe520/MathModelAgent.prompt_en: Use MathModelAgent on [problem.pdf] and [data.xlsx] to outline assumptions and notation, formulate the mathematical model for Problem 1, run Python solvers, and perform sensitivity analysis.
jihe520/MathModelAgent.output_zh: 输出完整建模思路、可运行求解代码、图表与规范竞赛论文段落。
jihe520/MathModelAgent.output_en: Produces modeling formulation, executable solver scripts, charts, and paper sections.

WUBING2023/PaperSpine.scenario_zh: 文献检索、分析与论文交付流水线
WUBING2023/PaperSpine.prompt_zh: 请使用 PaperSpine 围绕我的课题【绿色氢能催化剂寿命衰减机理】，先梳理近 5 年高引综述的核心分类体系，再帮我设计实验数据整理表格与论文 Results 部分的写作骨架。
WUBING2023/PaperSpine.prompt_en: Use PaperSpine on [degradation mechanisms of green hydrogen catalysts] to map taxonomy from recent reviews and draft a data summary table plus Results section skeleton.
WUBING2023/PaperSpine.output_zh: 产出文献分类表、数据汇总模板与结构化论文写作骨架。
WUBING2023/PaperSpine.output_en: Delivers a literature taxonomy, analysis table template, and Results section skeleton.

zLanqing/codex-claude-academic-skills.scenario_zh: 论文精读报告与学术文档/计算
zLanqing/codex-claude-academic-skills.prompt_zh: 请使用 office-academic-skill 精读当前目录下的【target_paper.pdf】，输出一份结构化文献阅读笔记（研究问题、核心方法、关键实验结论、方法局限与对我课题的启发），并整理为可直接汇报的提纲。
zLanqing/codex-claude-academic-skills.prompt_en: Use office-academic-skill to read [target_paper.pdf] and produce a structured reading report covering research question, method, key findings, limitations, and takeaways for my project.
zLanqing/codex-claude-academic-skills.output_zh: 产出条理清晰的论文精读报告与组会汇报要点提纲。
zLanqing/codex-claude-academic-skills.output_en: Generates a structured paper reading report and presentation bullet points.

AIScientists-Dev/academic-humanizer.scenario_zh: 去除 AI 腔调、保留学术原声
AIScientists-Dev/academic-humanizer.scenario_en: De-AI academic prose while preserving evidence
AIScientists-Dev/academic-humanizer.prompt_zh: 请使用 academic-humanizer 润色我这段英文摘要【abstract_draft.txt】：去除高频 AI 套话与过度工整的排比句，严格保留所有实验数值、专业术语与引用标记，并列出逐句修改说明。
AIScientists-Dev/academic-humanizer.prompt_en: Use academic-humanizer to polish [abstract_draft.txt]: remove formulaic AI phrasing while strictly preserving every number, technical term, and citation, and show a sentence-by-sentence change log.
AIScientists-Dev/academic-humanizer.output_zh: 输出自然克制的学术英文改写稿，以及零篡改数据的逐句对照说明。
AIScientists-Dev/academic-humanizer.output_en: Delivers natural scholarly rewrites with a sentence-by-sentence change log preserving all facts.

isaac-sim/IsaacLab.scenario_zh: 机器人强化学习与物理传感器仿真
isaac-sim/IsaacLab.prompt_zh: 请基于当前目录下的 Isaac Lab 环境配置，帮我检查四足机器人运动控制任务【locomotion_env_cfg.py】的观测空间、奖励函数权重与接触传感器配置，并给出使用 RSL RL 启动训练与评估的命令。
isaac-sim/IsaacLab.prompt_en: Inspect [locomotion_env_cfg.py] in this Isaac Lab workspace, review the quadruped observation space, reward weights, and contact sensor settings, and provide the RSL RL training and evaluation commands.
isaac-sim/IsaacLab.output_zh: 输出仿真环境参数诊断、奖励项调优建议与可执行的训练/评测命令。
isaac-sim/IsaacLab.output_en: Provides environment configuration diagnostics, reward tuning advice, and runnable training/evaluation commands.

sapientinc/PRAXIST.scenario_zh: 自主演进实验接管与多智能体科研循环
sapientinc/PRAXIST.prompt_zh: 请调用 $praxist-takeover 接管当前目录的可运行科研项目：先核验基线脚本与评估指标路径，不下载新数据集；在保持现有约束的前提下优化核心指标【val_score】，建立包含协议完整性检查与证据保留通道的 task harness，就绪检查通过后向我汇报运行计划。
sapientinc/PRAXIST.prompt_en: Invoke $praxist-takeover on the current runnable research project: verify the baseline and evaluation path without downloading new datasets, build a task harness to optimize [val_score] with protocol-integrity checks, and report the execution plan after readiness checks pass.
sapientinc/PRAXIST.output_zh: 自动完成基线评估核验、构建实验评测契约（task harness）并输出可监控的多代科研运行方案。
sapientinc/PRAXIST.output_en: Verifies baseline evaluation, constructs a durable task harness, and reports a monitorable multi-generation research plan.

icip-cas/PPTAgent.scenario_zh: 视觉审阅与可编辑学术汇报 PPTX 生成
icip-cas/PPTAgent.prompt_zh: 请使用 pptagent 技能，根据当前目录下的论文与实验结果【paper.md】，制作一份 8 页 16:9 学术组会汇报幻灯片（涵盖研究动机、方法框架、主实验对比与消融结论），对渲染页面进行视觉版式审阅后导出可编辑的【presentation.pptx】。
icip-cas/PPTAgent.prompt_en: Use the pptagent skill to create an 8-slide 16:9 academic presentation from [paper.md] covering motivation, method architecture, main results, and ablations; visually review the rendered slides and export an editable [presentation.pptx].
icip-cas/PPTAgent.output_zh: 经过多轮生成与视觉审阅修正，交付版式整洁、元素可在 PowerPoint 中直接编辑的 `.pptx` 文件。
icip-cas/PPTAgent.output_en: Generates, visually reviews, and exports a clean, directly editable `.pptx` slide deck.

aiming-lab/AutoResearchClaw.scenario_zh: 从研究想法到实验与论文初稿的端到端自演进科研
aiming-lab/AutoResearchClaw.prompt_zh: 请使用 AutoResearchClaw 围绕研究主题【小样本表格数据上的对比学习正则化】开展文献调研、提炼核心假设、设计基线对比实验并输出结构化论文初稿。
aiming-lab/AutoResearchClaw.prompt_en: Use AutoResearchClaw on [contrastive regularization for few-shot tabular learning] to survey literature, formulate testable hypotheses, design baseline comparisons, and draft a structured manuscript.
aiming-lab/AutoResearchClaw.output_zh: 自动串联文献检索、实验假设设计、代码验证与论文各章节草稿。
aiming-lab/AutoResearchClaw.output_en: Coordinates literature survey, hypothesis formulation, experiment validation, and manuscript drafting.

Companion-Inc/feynman.scenario_zh: 文献综述、论文代码一致性审计与审稿评审
Companion-Inc/feynman.scenario_en: Literature synthesis, paper-code audit & peer review
Companion-Inc/feynman.prompt_zh: 请使用 feynman 的 /lit 与 /audit 工作流，围绕【扩散模型在蛋白质构象生成中的最新进展】梳理学术共识与争议，并核对当前目录下论文初稿的核心结论与公开代码实现是否一致。
Companion-Inc/feynman.prompt_en: Use feynman's /lit and /audit workflows on [diffusion models for protein conformation generation] to synthesize consensus and open questions, and verify manuscript claims against the code.
Companion-Inc/feynman.output_zh: 产出带引用核验的文献对比矩阵、论文-代码一致性审计报告与分级修改建议。
Companion-Inc/feynman.output_en: Produces citation-checked literature synthesis, paper-to-code audit findings, and prioritized revision notes.
